item.title: The Surf in Los Angeles Has Been Heavy Lately
item.description: Los Angeles always gets good in the winter. And the surf around the South Bay has been heavy lately.

item.title: Northstar Records Third Fatality in Two Weeks as Search for Missing Skier Ends
item.description: A 21-year-old skier identified as Colin Kang was found deceased at Northstar. It's the third fatal skiing accident this month at the resort.

item.title: Behind the Scenes of ‘The Search for Volcano Island,’ One of the Best Surf Films in Years
item.description: Ben Weiland's "The Search for Volcano Island" was an extremely demanding surf film to make. It was a daunting process. This is the backstory.

item.title: Skier Hunter Hess Fires Back at Trump, Embracing ‘Loser’ Label
item.description: American freestyle skier Hunter Hess has decided to embrace a label given to him by Donald Trump in an online attack.

item.title: Lindsey Vonn Posts Update After Olympic Crash Ruined Her Leg
item.description: Lindsey Vonn did not have an easy go of the Olympics. And in the wake of her complex tibia fracture her recovery is not going as smoothly as she'd hoped.

item.title: Major Changes Are Coming to Surfing’s Olympic Qualification System
item.description: The International Surfing Association has announced sweeping changes to the Olympic qualification system for LA 2028. The new pathway backloads qualification to the 2028 calendar year and increases the importance of the World Surfing Games relative to the WSL Championship Tour. It also raises the country quota from two surfers of each gender per country […]

item.title: Nick Goepper Misses Podium Due to Brutal Crash in Freeski Halfpipe Final
item.description: At the Olympic Men's Freeski Halfpipe Final, Nick Goepper closed out a potentially medal-winning run with a brutal crash and a trip to the medic.

item.title: Jim Ryan Skis a Nearly Impossible Couloir Called ‘The Zombie Apocalypse’
item.description: Jim Ryan can do things on skis that most can't, which made him perfect to attempt the Zombie Apocalypse couloir in the Tetons. It's a wild ride.

item.title: A Surfer Examines Robert Duvall’s Most Famous Line Ever, In One of His Most Iconic Roles
item.description: On February 15, legendary actor Robert Duvall passed away at 95. Sam George reexamines his famous surfing line from 'Apocalypse Now.'

item.title: LJ Henriquez, Telma Särkipaju Win Red Bull Heavy Metal In Front of Massive Boston Crowd
item.description: Boston proved to be a rowdy venue for the Red Bull Heavy Metal street snowboarding contest. And the riders fed off the massive crowd's energy.
